code: freeLabel(label);       /* free any structures allocated before EOF */
note: On EOF inside LABEL, loadLabel frees a label object that is owned by its caller and leaves its fields and refcount in a freed state for later map cleanup.
The EOF failure propagates out of LEGEND loading while the same legend label object remains part of the map object.
The failed map load cleans up the partially initialized map that still contains the previously freed legend label state.
Map cleanup calls freeLabel again on the same caller-owned legend label object after loadLabel already freed it on EOF.
The second freeLabel invocation uses the stale label fields and frees the already-freed input-controlled font pointer, triggering the sanitizer-detected heap-use-after-free/double-free path.
